name: Server Slayer Loop
hook: An automated health bot decides all healthy servers must die
tagline: As your multiplier rises, an automated server-health robot patrols an infinite data center, labeling green racks as hazardous and executing them with a giant rubber mallet. Cash out to eject your server rack safely onto a backup dolly before the script flags it. Crash and the robot triggers a total hypervisor purge, plunging the datacenter into total blackness and blue screens.
